result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it narrows Customer’s indemnity to Customer-provided materials and legal violations, adds Vendor indemnities for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Vendor-caused Customer Data compromise, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and includes standard procedures. Unrelated pricing terms are preserved. However, the draft adds some unnecessary breadth, including Vendor Technology and Customer-controlled infringement remedies, and contains defective cross-references to Sections 20.2(a) and 20.2 even though the added paragraphs are not numbered. The margin comment also incorrectly references Section 9.3 and a nonexistent Section 20.5.
